unresolved_heading_resolution.RH.S01: The OCR TOC label 'Acromyms' is an acronym list. Body OCR on PDF 1496 confirms the real printed headings Anatomy of Joint Pathology and Basics of Immunology; these are represented by SU-RH-01.
unresolved_heading_resolution.RH.S04: Body OCR on PDF 1499 confirms the additional printed heading Degenerative Arthritis: Osteoarthritis under the merged TOC node; it is represented separately by SU-RH-06.
unresolved_heading_resolution.BODY:Raynaud's Phenomenon: Body OCR on PDF 1506 confirms Raynaud's Phenomenon within systemic lupus/connective-tissue content. It is retained within SU-RH-09 rather than made a standalone unit.

study_units.title: Joint anatomy and basic immunology
study_units.structural_rationale: Body-recovered Anatomy of Joint Pathology and Basics of Immunology are coherent foundational context; the acronym glossary itself is not separately testable.

study_units.title: Immune mechanisms and immunogenetics of rheumatic disease
source_hierarchy_path: Immune Mechanisms of Disease; Immunogenetics and Disease
study_units.structural_rationale: The two adjacent source topics jointly supply background mechanisms rather than separate clinical decisions.

study_units.title: Approach to joint pain and patterns of joint involvement
study_units.structural_rationale: One presentation-based diagnostic approach covering articular versus non-articular and mono-/oligo-/polyarticular patterns.

study_units.title: Synovial fluid analysis
study_units.structural_rationale: A distinct investigation-selection and interpretation skill.

study_units.title: Septic arthritis
study_units.structural_rationale: A time-critical acute monoarthritis requiring immediate recognition, aspiration/cultures, and escalation; split from the merged osteoarthritis heading.

study_units.title: Osteoarthritis
study_units.structural_rationale: Body-recovered printed heading; a common chronic articular presentation with a diagnostic and initial-management approach distinct from septic arthritis.

study_units.title: Seropositive rheumatic disease and autoantibody interpretation
study_units.structural_rationale: A cross-condition serology reference that supports interpretation within the individual disease units.

study_units.title: Rheumatoid arthritis
study_units.structural_rationale: A common chronic inflammatory polyarthritis with its own recognition, investigation, complications, and referral decisions.

study_units.title: Systemic lupus erythematosus and Raynaud phenomenon
study_units.structural_rationale: The body-only Raynaud's Phenomenon heading is within this source block and is clinically retained with multisystem SLE recognition rather than inflated to an extra TOC-derived unit.

study_units.title: Antiphospholipid antibody syndrome
study_units.structural_rationale: A distinct thrombotic and pregnancy-morbidity syndrome with specific recognition and referral implications.

study_units.title: Systemic sclerosis
study_units.structural_rationale: A distinct multisystem connective-tissue disease requiring recognition of organ complications and referral.

study_units.title: Idiopathic inflammatory myopathies
study_units.structural_rationale: A distinct proximal-weakness syndrome with diagnostic and complication-recognition decisions.

study_units.title: Sjögren syndrome
study_units.structural_rationale: A discrete sicca syndrome with systemic associations and referral implications.

study_units.title: Mixed connective tissue disease
study_units.structural_rationale: Retained as its own source-traceable topic but limited to recognition and referral at graduating-student depth.

study_units.title: Overlap syndrome
study_units.structural_rationale: A source-distinct specialist diagnostic category retained only as contextual recognition.

study_units.title: Small-vessel non-ANCA-associated vasculitis
study_units.structural_rationale: A source-distinct vasculitis category, scoped to recognition of systemic disease and referral rather than subtype treatment details.

study_units.title: ANCA-associated vasculitis
study_units.structural_rationale: A distinct pulmonary-renal systemic vasculitis pattern where prompt recognition and urgent referral are clinically coherent at this depth.

study_units.title: Medium-vessel vasculitis
study_units.structural_rationale: A source-distinct category, limited to recognition of systemic vasculitis and appropriate referral.

study_units.title: Large-vessel vasculitis
study_units.structural_rationale: Giant-cell-arteritis recognition, especially visual-risk escalation, makes this category distinct from other vasculitides.

study_units.title: Ankylosing spondylitis
study_units.structural_rationale: A distinct inflammatory-back-pain pattern with extra-articular complications and referral decisions.

study_units.title: Enteropathic arthritis
study_units.structural_rationale: A source-distinct joint manifestation of inflammatory bowel disease; retained for recognition and cross-discipline linkage.

study_units.title: Psoriatic arthritis
study_units.structural_rationale: A distinct inflammatory arthritis pattern with skin and joint recognition decisions.

study_units.title: Reactive arthritis
study_units.structural_rationale: A distinct postinfectious arthritis with a characteristic multisystem presentation.

study_units.title: Gout
study_units.structural_rationale: A common acute monoarthritis requiring recognition, aspiration-based differentiation, and initial management concepts.

study_units.title: Calcium pyrophosphate deposition disease
study_units.structural_rationale: A source-distinct acute monoarthritis differential, kept separate from gout because crystal findings and risk context differ.

study_units.title: Polymyalgia rheumatica
study_units.structural_rationale: A distinct proximal-pain syndrome, coupled to recognition of temporal-arteritis risk and referral.

study_units.title: Fibromyalgia
study_units.structural_rationale: A common generalized-pain disorder with a distinct diagnostic approach and nonpharmacologic initial management concepts.

study_units.title: Rheumatology medications
study_units.structural_rationale: Medication tables support awareness of broad classes and safety but drug doses and specialty regimens are not independent scope-stage targets.

study_units.title: Landmark rheumatology trials
study_units.structural_rationale: Historical trial summaries are reference material, not an independent graduating-student competency.

study_units.title: Rheumatology references
study_units.structural_rationale: Chapter bibliography; no independent clinical content.
